records.text: Owens said Jaco Bouyens runs a charity for child sex abuse victims, but she did not know whether it was called All Things Possible and thought the spreadsheet might have duplicated that name.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jaco Bouyens (charity founder; name spelling unverified) also runs a charity for child sex abuse. I don't know if his is called All Things Possible. We might have put that twice. ... But he does run a charity for child sex abuse victims.
